text:
Which statement about the trends shown by the elements of Period 3 in the Periodic Table is not
correct?
A
The elements become less metallic across the period.
B
The group number increases across the period.
C
The number of electron shells increases across the period.
D
The number of outer electrons increases across the period.

options.label: A
options.text: The elements become less metallic across the period.

options.label: B
options.text: The group number increases across the period.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of electron shells increases across the period.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of outer electrons increases across the period.
